why: By the power rule of integration $\displaystyle\int x^{n}dx = \dfrac{x^{n+1}}{n+1}$. $\displaystyle\int_0^{1}(3x^{2}+6x)dx = \left[\dfrac{3x^{3}}{3} + \dfrac{6x^{2}}{2}\right]_0^{1}$ $= 4$
